candidates.text: Knit fabric is stored in Kilograms (Kgs).
Woven fabric is stored in Meters (Mtrs).
To ensure accurate stock management, users must have the option to update movement units in storage UOM directly in GRN, along with an auto-calculated UOM Conversion Factor.
If Allow Indent Qty in Storage UOM is enabled → Indents generated in Storage UOM.
Created in Storage UOM, based on BOM conversion.

Section 2. 📘Scope:
1. Techpack Enhancements
2. Secondary UOM conversion defined in Techpack will auto-populate in Color/Size-wise Conversion.
3. BOM will store and freeze the Secondary UOM conversion at the time of creation.
4. MRP & Indent Calculation
5. On MRP run, system calculates requirements in Storage UOM using conversion from BOM.
6. If Allow Indent Qty in Storage UOM is enabled → Indents generated in Storage UOM.
7. If disabled → Indents generated in Consumption UOM.
8. GRN Enhancements
9. Add Movement Units (Storage UOM) column in GRN.
10. Column auto-populates using Conversion Factor.
11. Both Storage UOM and Conversion Factor remain editable (with reciprocal recalculation).
12. On GRN confirmation → Inventory updates in Storage UOM.
13. Production Orders
14. Created in Storage UOM, based on BOM conversion.
15. All downstream transactions (Pick List, GDN, Transfers, Adjustments) processed in Storage UOM.
Applicability: Functionality applies only when Order UOM ≠ Storage UOM.
Reporting Impact: Inventory and stock reports must show Storage UOM.

Section 3. 📌Assumptions:
1. Master Data: UOM setup (Consumption, Purchase, Storage & Secondary) is correctly maintained.
2. Applicability: Functionality applies only when Order UOM ≠ Storage UOM.
3. Permissions: Only authorized GRN users can edit Storage UOM or Conversion Factor.
4. System Behaviour:
5. Updates affect only current GRNs (no impact on historical POs/GRNs).
6. Inventory, reporting, and stock status consistently reflect Storage UOM post-GRN confirmation.
7. Data Accuracy: Users are responsible for entering accurate Storage UOM values as per supplier packing lists.
8. Reporting Impact: Inventory and stock reports must show Storage UOM.

Section 5: 🧪 Acceptance Criteria:
1. GRN allows entry and auto-population of Movement Units (Storage UOM).

chunks.title: 🎯Purpose
chunks.heading: Section 1: 🧾Overview › 🎯Purpose
chunks.text: This enhancement introduces functionality of secondary uom conversion & it’s impacts throughout the transactions.
chunks.locator: § Section 1: 🧾Overview › 🎯Purpose

chunks.title: 🏢Business Requirement:
chunks.heading: Section 1: 🧾Overview › 🏢Business Requirement:
chunks.text:
As per company policy:
• Knit fabric is stored in Kilograms (Kgs).
• Woven fabric is stored in Meters (Mtrs).
However, the consumption and purchase UOM for knit fabric is Meters, since suppliers invoice and ship in meters. Supplier packing lists also provide details in both purchase UOM (meters) and storage UOM (kilograms).
To ensure accurate stock management, users must have the option to update movement units in storage UOM directly in GRN, along with an auto-calculated UOM Conversion Factor.
.
chunks.locator: § Section 1: 🧾Overview › 🏢Business Requirement:

chunks.title: Section 2. 📘Scope
chunks.heading: Section 2. 📘Scope
chunks.text:
• Techpack Enhancements
• Secondary UOM conversion defined in Techpack will auto-populate in Color/Size-wise Conversion.
• BOM will store and freeze the Secondary UOM conversion at the time of creation.
• MRP & Indent Calculation
• On MRP run, system calculates requirements in Storage UOM using conversion from BOM.
• If Allow Indent Qty in Storage UOM is enabled → Indents generated in Storage UOM.
• If disabled → Indents generated in Consumption UOM.
• GRN Enhancements
• Add Movement Units (Storage UOM) column in GRN.
• Column auto-populates using Conversion Factor.
• Both Storage UOM and Conversion Factor remain editable (with reciprocal recalculation).
• On GRN confirmation → Inventory updates in Storage UOM.
• Production Orders
• Created in Storage UOM, based on BOM conversion.
• All downstream transactions (Pick List, GDN, Transfers, Adjustments) processed in Storage UOM.
chunks.locator: § Section 2. 📘Scope

chunks.title: Section 3. 📌Assumptions
chunks.heading: Section 3. 📌Assumptions
chunks.text:
• Master Data: UOM setup (Consumption, Purchase, Storage & Secondary) is correctly maintained.
• Applicability: Functionality applies only when Order UOM ≠ Storage UOM.
• Permissions: Only authorized GRN users can edit Storage UOM or Conversion Factor.
• System Behaviour:
• Updates affect only current GRNs (no impact on historical POs/GRNs).
• Inventory, reporting, and stock status consistently reflect Storage UOM post-GRN confirmation.
• Data Accuracy: Users are responsible for entering accurate Storage UOM values as per supplier packing lists.
• Reporting Impact: Inventory and stock reports must show Storage UOM.
chunks.locator: § Section 3. 📌Assumptions

chunks.title: Screen: Catalog>>Textile/Fabric (Knit Fabric)
chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution › … › … › … › Screen: Catalog>>Textile/Fabric (Knit Fabric)
chunks.text:
In Techpack, users define:
• Consumption UOM & Purchase UOM (e.g., Meter)
• Storage UOM (Kgs)
• Secondary UOM (Meter)
• Secondary UOM Conversion (0.090)
Once the conversion is defined in Techpack, it will auto add the line in Color/Size wise Conversion with option “All Other” in color & size with the same conversion which will be freeze as shown in below screen.
If user changed the conversion on techpack main page it will auto update in the “Color/Size Conversion” and user can able to define color & Size wise conversion in the grid. If conversion is not defined for any color/size then it will be calculated with ALL Other conversion factor.
Note: Conversion will be calculated based on Storage UOM to Secondary UOM ( Just for refernce).
Storage UOM is PCS and Secondary UOM is KG, it means the conversion which is defined on techpack or color/size conversion grid between Storage UOM to Secondary UOM for instance: 1 Pcs is equal to 0.09 KG.
chunks.locator: § Section 4. 🛠️Solution › … › … › … › Screen: Catalog>>Textile/Fabric (Knit Fabric)

chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution › … › … › … › Screen: MRP
chunks.text:
In MRP, Produced Qty page will show the Secondary UOM & Secondary UOM Conversion from Techpack.
If user revise the standard conversion in Techpack then system will not auto change the conversion in MRP, but if user rerun the MRP then it will show the latest conversion from techpack & system will generate the requirement accordingly.
If Setting “Allow Indent Qty in Storage UOM.” Is enabled then system generates the Indent requirement in Storage UOM. In above scenario the storage UOM is Kgs & consumption UOM is Meter, based on the secondary UOM conversion system should generate the requirement in Kgs. Required visibility in MRP to show the Secondary UOM & Secondary UOM Conversion (Based on Misc. Setting) so that user can validate how system calculated the requirement in Storage UOM as shown in below screen.
‘Cons. Qty In Secondary UOM’ Should be calculated based on Secondary UOM Conversion, it should be visible if Misc. setting –‘Enable Textile Module’.
In case Consumption UOM and Storage UOM is same and user still defined the ‘Secondary UOM Conversion’ so consumption qty not check for secondary UOM conversion, also requirement should not generate based on ‘Secondary UOM Conversion’.
To Understand the concept let’s plot one example:
• Cons UOM is MTR.
• Storage UOM is KG.
• KG to MTR conversion is defined in the UOM Conversion Master is 0.3590. It means 1 KG is equal to 0.359 MTR.

chunks.title: Section 5: 🧪 Acceptance Criteria
chunks.heading: Section 5: 🧪 Acceptance Criteria
chunks.text:
• GRN allows entry and auto-population of Movement Units (Storage UOM).
• Updating Movement Units (Storage UOM) recalculates Conversion Factor automatically.
• Updating Conversion Factor recalculates Movement Units (Storage UOM) automatically.
• If Order UOM = Storage UOM → Storage UOM field disabled/hidden.
• On GRN confirmation → Inventory updates in Storage UOM.
• QC outcomes (rejection, shortage, excess) recorded and reflected in Storage UOM.
• All downstream processes (Pick List, GDN, Transfers, Adjustments) reference Storage UOM consistently.
• Reports display clear distinction between ordered, received, rejected, shortage, and excess in Storage UOM.
chunks.locator: § Section 5: 🧪 Acceptance Criteria

chunks.title: Scenario 1: Auto-population of Storage UOM
chunks.heading: Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 1: Auto-population of Storage UOM
chunks.text:
• Pre-condition: PO created in Meters; Storage UOM defined as Kgs.
• Action: User enters quantity in Transaction UOM (Meters).
• Expected Result: Movement Unit (Storage UOM) auto-populates based on default Conversion Factor.
• Acceptance Criteria: System correctly calculates Movement Units (Storage UOM) using defined conversion.
chunks.locator: § Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 1: Auto-population of Storage UOM

chunks.title: Scenario 2: Manual Update of Storage UOM
chunks.heading: Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 2: Manual Update of Storage UOM
chunks.text:
• Pre-condition: GRN line with auto-populated Storage UOM.
• Action: User manually updates Movement Units (Storage UOM).
• Expected Result: Conversion Factor recalculates automatically.
• Acceptance Criteria: Conversion Factor is updated correctly and remains consistent with new Movement Units (Storage UOM).
chunks.locator: § Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 2: Manual Update of Storage UOM

chunks.title: Scenario 3: Manual Update of Conversion Factor
chunks.heading: Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 3: Manual Update of Conversion Factor
chunks.text:
• Pre-condition: GRN with Movement Units (Transaction UOM) & Movement Units (Storage UOM).
• Action: User edits Conversion Factor.
• Expected Result: Movement Units (Storage UOM) updates accordingly.
• Acceptance Criteria: System recalculates and displays correct Movement Units (Storage UOM) quantity.
chunks.locator: § Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 3: Manual Update of Conversion Factor

chunks.title: Scenario 4: GRN Confirmation & Stock Update
chunks.heading: Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 4: GRN Confirmation & Stock Update
chunks.text:
• Pre-condition: GRN created with updated Movement Units (Storage UOM) values.
• Action: User confirms GRN.
• Expected Result: Stock updates as per Movement Units (Storage UOM).
• Acceptance Criteria:
• Inventory reflects Storage UOM correctly.
• Roll Units & subsequent transactions (Pick List, GDN, Transfers, Reallocation, Adjustments) show Storage UOM consistently.
chunks.locator: § Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 4: GRN Confirmation & Stock Update

chunks.title: Scenario 5: Validation When Order UOM = Storage UOM
chunks.heading: Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 5: Validation When Order UOM = Storage UOM
chunks.text:
• Pre-condition: PO created with same UOM for both Order & Storage.
• Action: User tries to update Storage UOM in GRN.
• Expected Result: Storage UOM update option not applicable.
• Acceptance Criteria: System disables or hides Storage UOM field in this case.
chunks.locator: § Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 5: Validation When Order UOM = Storage UOM

chunks.title: Scenario 6: QC Outcome – Rejection Handling
chunks.heading: Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 6: QC Outcome – Rejection Handling
chunks.text:
• Pre-condition: GRN created and QC performed.
• Action: User rejects part of the received quantity during QC.
• Expected Result:
• Rejected quantity is updated in stock in storage UOM.
• Acceptance Criteria:
• System records rejected quantity separately with quality as “Rejected” in Storage UOM.
chunks.locator: § Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 6: QC Outcome – Rejection Handling

chunks.title: Scenario 7: QC Outcome – Shortage Handling
chunks.heading: Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 7: QC Outcome – Shortage Handling
chunks.text:
• Pre-condition: PO created for 100 Meters (equivalent Storage UOM in Kgs available).
• Action: During QC, actual received quantity is less than ordered (e.g., 90 Meters).
• Expected Result:
• GRN reflects shortage quantity.
• Storage UOM updates accordingly.
• Acceptance Criteria:
• Shortage is recorded in the GRN.
• Inventory is updated only with the accepted quantity in Storage UOM.
• Reports clearly distinguish between ordered vs received.
chunks.locator: § Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 7: QC Outcome – Shortage Handling

chunks.title: Scenario 8: QC Outcome – Excess Handling
chunks.heading: Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 8: QC Outcome – Excess Handling
chunks.text:
• Pre-condition: PO created for 100 Meters.
• Action: During QC, actual received quantity is higher (e.g., 105 Meters).
• Expected Result:
• GRN reflects excess quantity.
• Storage UOM updates accordingly.
• Acceptance Criteria:
• Excess is captured in the GRN.
• System updates inventory with excess in Storage UOM.
chunks.locator: § Section 6: Test Cases › … › Scenario 8: QC Outcome – Excess Handling
